releases.body:
- Verified compatible with OpenCode 2.2.0
- Dev dependencies bumped: @opencode/plugin 2.2.0, @opentui/core and @opentui/solid 0.7.0
- No changes to plugin behavior

- Fix: TUI failed to load when installed from GitHub or npm ("Cannot find package 'react'"). It now ships precompiled.
- Fix: installing from GitHub no longer fails with "git dep preparation failed".

First release.

- `/goal <condition>`: agent keeps working until an evaluator confirms the condition
- `/goal` shows status, `/goal clear` removes it
- Met / not met / impossible verdicts, cached-context evaluator (optional separate model)
- Pauses on stalls, interrupts, rate limits; retries transient errors; clears on fatal ones
- Waits for subagents and background shells with check-ins
- Restores active goals after restart
- TUI footer indicator, toasts, status dialog
